multiple.description: Whether to select more than one

value-key.description: As a key name that is uniquely identified by value, it is required if the binding value is an object type
value-key.description_zh: 作为 value 唯一标识的键名，绑定值为对象类型时必填

size.description: Enter the size of the field

clearable.description: Whether the option can be cleared

collapse-tags.description: When multiple selections are made, whether the selected values are displayed in the form of text
collapse-tags.description_zh: 多选时是否将选中值按文字的形式展示

:multiple-limit.description: When multi-selecting, the maximum number of items that a user can select is not limited if it is 0
:multiple-limit.description_zh: 多选时用户最多可以选择的项目数，为 0 则不限制

name.description_zh: select input 的 name 属性

autocomplete.description_zh: select input 的 autocomplete 属性

auto-complete.description: The next major version is deprecated

allow-create.description: Whether or not to allow users to create new entries needs to be used with 'filterable'
allow-create.description_zh: 是否允许用户创建新条目，需配合 `filterable` 使用

remote.description: Whether it is a remote search

loading.description: Whether data is being obtained from a remote location
loading.description_zh: 是否正在从远程获取数据

loading-text.description: The text that is displayed when loaded remotely
loading-text.description_zh: 远程加载时显示的文字

no-match-text.description: If the search conditions do not match, you can also use the 'slot="empty"' setting
no-match-text.description_zh: 搜索条件无匹配时显示的文字，也可以使用`slot="empty"`设置

no-data-text.description: The text that is displayed when the option is empty, you can also use the 'slot="empty" setting
no-data-text.description_zh: 选项为空时显示的文字，也可以使用`slot="empty"`设置

reserve-keyword.description: If you have multiple selections and are searchable, whether to keep the current search terms after selecting an option
reserve-keyword.description_zh: 多选且可搜索时，是否在选中一个选项后保留当前的搜索关键词

default-first-option.description: Press Enter in the input box and select the first match. Requires use with 'filterable' or 'remote'
default-first-option.description_zh: 在输入框按下回车，选择第一个匹配项。需配合 `filterable` 或 `remote` 使用

popper-append-to-body.description: Whether to insert a popover into the body element. If there is a problem with the positioning of the popover, you can set the property to false
popper-append-to-body.description_zh: 是否将弹出框插入至 body 元素。在弹出框的定位出现问题时，可将该属性设置为 false

automatic-dropdown.description: For non-searchable Select, whether the options menu will automatically pop up after the input box gains focus
automatic-dropdown.description_zh: 对于不可搜索的 Select，是否在输入框获得焦点后自动弹出选项菜单

empty-text.description: The text that is displayed when the content is empty
empty-text.description_zh: 内容为空的时候展示的文本

node-key.description: Each tree node is used as a uniquely identified attribute, and the entire tree should be unique
node-key.description_zh: 每个树节点用来作为唯一标识的属性，整棵树应该是唯一的

:props.description: For configuration options, see the following table

render-after-expand.description: Whether to render a tree node after its children are first expanded
render-after-expand.description_zh: 是否在第一次展开某个树节点后才渲染其子节点

:load.description: The method of loading subtree data, which only takes effect if the lazy property is true
:load.description_zh: 加载子树数据的方法，仅当 lazy 属性为true 时生效

:render-content.description: Rendering function for the content area of the tree node
:render-content.description_zh: 树节点的内容区的渲染 Function

highlight-current.description: Whether to highlight the currently selected node, the default value is false.
highlight-current.description_zh: 是否高亮当前选中节点，默认值是 false。

default-expand-all.description: Whether to expand all nodes by default
default-expand-all.description_zh: 是否默认展开所有节点

expand-on-click-node.description: Whether to expand or contract a node when clicking on a node, the default value is true, if false, the node will only be expanded or contracted when the arrow icon is clicked.
expand-on-click-node.description_zh: 是否在点击节点的时候展开或者收缩节点， 默认值为 true，如果为 false，则只有点箭头图标的时候才会展开或者收缩节点。

check-on-click-node.description: Whether to select a node when clicking on a node, the default value is false, that is, the node will only be selected when the checkbox is clicked.
check-on-click-node.description_zh: 是否在点击节点的时候选中节点，默认值为 false，即只有在点击复选框时才会选中节点。

auto-expand-parent.description: Whether the parent node is automatically expanded when the child node is expanded
auto-expand-parent.description_zh: 展开子节点的时候是否自动展开父节点

:default-expanded-keys.description: An array of the keys of the nodes that are expanded by default
:default-expanded-keys.description_zh: 默认展开的节点的 key 的数组

show-checkbox.description: Whether the node can be selected

check-strictly.description: In the case of the display of the check box, whether the practice of not associating father and son from each other is strictly followed, defaults to false
check-strictly.description_zh: 在显示复选框的情况下，是否严格的遵循父子不互相关联的做法，默认为 false

:default-checked-keys.description: An array of node keys that are checked by default
:default-checked-keys.description_zh: 默认勾选的节点的 key 的数组

:filter-node-method.description: When filtering a tree node, a method that returns true indicates that the node can be displayed, and a return of false indicates that the node will be hidden
:filter-node-method.description_zh: 对树节点进行筛选时执行的方法，返回 true 表示这个节点可以显示，返回 false 则表示这个节点会被隐藏

accordion.description: Whether to open only one sibling tree node at a time
accordion.description_zh: 是否每次只打开一个同级树节点展开

:indent.description: Horizontal indentation between adjacent nodes, in pixels
:indent.description_zh: 相邻级节点间的水平缩进，单位为像素

icon-class.description: Customize the icon of the tree node

lazy.description: Whether to lazy load child nodes or not needs to be used in conjunction with the load method
lazy.description_zh: 是否懒加载子节点，需与 load 方法结合使用

draggable.description: Whether to enable the drag and drop node function
draggable.description_zh: 是否开启拖拽节点功能

:allow-drag.description: Determine whether the node can be dragged or not

:allow-drop.description: Determines whether the target node can be placed when dragging. There are three cases for the 'type' parameter: 'prev', 'inner', and 'next', which represent placement before, insertion, and post-target nodes, respectively
:allow-drop.description_zh: 拖拽时判定目标节点能否被放置。`type` 参数有三种情况：'prev'、'inner' 和 'next'，分别表示放置在目标节点前、插入至目标节点和放置在目标节点后
